_comment: Non-secret identifiers only. The development Supabase project ref is a public identifier (it appears in the project URL). Production's ref is intentionally not listed here: guards only need to recognize the DEV project. `features` gates native sign-in/push configuration per variant. Production (release 1.1, enabled 2026-10-10): Apple and Google sign-in on, push entitlement OFF (notifications are local only). `google.webClientId` is the Google OAuth Web client ID for that Supabase project; it is read only by supabase/dev/configure-auth.py, never by the app.
